title: [DE] Support registration numbers in E-Documents
summary: E-Document import and export processing now handles registration numbers for vendor matching and supports German FC tax identifiers in multiple document formats.
key_points: Registration number becomes final fallback for matching imported vendors in E-Documents
German FC tax identifiers supported in XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, and PEPPOL exports
Imported receiving-company registration number validated against Company Information
Extended E-Document, vendor, and company information tables with registration number fields
Test coverage added for registration number vendor matching and document export scenarios
quote: add Registration No. as the final fallback when matching imported E-Document vendors
